title: ScheduledTask
description: Envelope schema for a ScheduledTask upsert. Structural gate only — per-step `arguments` are validated separately against each tool's own registered input_schema (see services/validation.rs). Semantic rules (reason needs context, provider_hint routing, {{_prev}} references) stay in lint_chain_steps as warnings.

name.description: MERGE key. A task with this name is updated in place, else created.

data_class.description: private (default when absent) = only no_log providers; public also admits free tiers that may train on prompts. A file-level value is stamped onto steps that set none.

interval_seconds.description: Recurrence cadence. The scheduler polls on SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_SECS; a sub-60s cadence is meaningless.

next_run_at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant of the next dispatch. Defaults to now on create.

managed_by.description: yaml = force-synced from schedules/*.yaml every startup; runtime = graph-owned, seeder never touches.

steps.description: ChainStep array, enqueued verbatim at dispatch (no goal_to_steps, no adversarial/evaluator, no auto-retrieval).

tool_name.description: Must name a registered tool (enforced live against the tool registry, not this schema).

arguments.description: Tool arguments. Validated against the named tool's own input_schema at the write boundary.

provider_hint.description: Top-level, sibling of tool_name/arguments. `ollama` = local; omission or anything else routes to the active cloud model. Putting it inside arguments is silently ignored by routing.

data_class.description: private (default when absent) = only no_log providers; public also admits free tiers that may train on prompts. A file-level value is stamped onto steps that set none.
